Memory._note: Empty = %LOCALAPPDATA%/SoulCore/memory/soulcore_memory.db. Never point at LLMOD Data/.

Inference._note: MaxTokens=num_predict (reply length). NumCtx=context window (gemma4 max ~131072; not 256K). Enabled=false → NullInferenceClient. EmbeddingsEnabled=false → RecallRecentAsync-only. MaxToolIterations caps /api/chat agent-loop round-trips (BED-126); default 8.

Hermes._note: Chat requires SOULCORE_HERMES_API_KEY (env/user-secrets). Do not put ApiKey values in this file.

ChatWs._note: Presence clients: ws://127.0.0.1:7700/ws. StubWhenModelDown=false → error frame chat.model_down when LLM unreachable (no silent stub success). Companion token is NOT configured here — use env SOULCORE_COMPANION_API_TOKEN (≥32 random chars). When set, /ws requires Authorization: Bearer or X-Api-Key; when unset, local loopback desktop keeps no-header trust.

UnrealBridge._note: Canonical UE project for :8888 still open freeze — default documented. Host must not crash if UE down.

SoulLoop._note: KILL SWITCH: Enabled=false by default. Scaffold only (want log / loop.want). No browser/MT4/email/file acts. Set true only for local evidence. ReflectionIntervalTicks=0 disables loop-authored reflection writes.

Safety._note: Phase 3 safety knobs. Rates default $0 (set per provider). MonthlyTokenCap=0 disables token ceiling. When CapExceeded, chat inference is refused (chat.spend_cap).

Tools._note: BED-133 filesystem + BED-135 desktop. Filesystem: empty Roots + UseDefaultRoots=true → defaults (memory read-only, qa-*/scratch rw). Desktop: AllowDesktopCapture (default true) for screenshot/list/focus; AllowComputerControl (default false, session opt-in) for click/type/key. DesktopBackend=native (Pass) or hermes (OPS-143 stretch).

_secrets_note: Do not put API tokens here. Use env SOULCORE_* or `dotnet user-secrets`. Key names: SOULCORE_A2E_TOKEN, SOULCORE_HERMES_API_KEY, SOULCORE_HF_TOKEN, SOULCORE_COMPANION_API_TOKEN.
